questions.question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The director hired the new employee after the interview.

options.text: The new employee will be hired by the director after the interview.
The new employee was hired by the director after the interview.
The new employee is being hired by the director after the interview.
The new employee hired by the director after the interview.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** "The new employee was hired by the director after the interview."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'director.'​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'new employee'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• 'Hired' will be changed into 'was hired'. 
 
• "New employee" is a singular subject and we must use "was" with it.
 
• The preposition "by" is used to indicate the doer of the action in the passive voice.
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 2.

 ​

Correct sentence: *The new employee was hired by the director after the interview.*

questions.question:
**Direction: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.**

A. That the only true individual

B. Is the holy man

C. It has frequently been claimed

D. Which the traditional society of India tolerates
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"C, A, D, B."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct order, C, A, D, B, makes a coherent grammatical and logical argument and narrative which states:
 
 
• C. It has frequently been claimed: This sentence introduces the claim or thesis, so it serves as the leading statement or introduction. It informs the reader that an assertion is about to be discussed which has been made multiple times before.
 
• A. That the only true individual: This phrase extends the claim mentioned in paragraph "C." It tells us the subject of this claim is a particular type of person categorized as the 'true individual,' but does not specify yet who this individual is.
 
• D. Whom the traditional society of India tolerates: This part of the sentence is specifying who this 'true individual' is. It suggests that this individual is someone who is tolerated by traditional society in India. At this point, the reader knows the claim is about a particular type of individual who is acceptable in traditional Indian society.
 
• B. Is the holy man: The final phrase, "Is the holy man," serves as the conclusion of the argument. It identifies and clarifies who this 'true individual' is. It finalizes the claim by stating that this 'true individual,' tolerated by traditional Indian society, is a holy man.
 
 
 
• This ordering provides a complete, coherent thought and is chronologically correct because it starts by stating the claim, identifies the topic, gives a further attribute to this topic regarding its acceptance in traditional Indian society, and ends by identifying who exactly this 'true individual' is - a holy man.

**Correct sentence**: *It has frequently been claimed (C) that the only true individual (A) which the traditional society of India tolerates (D) **is the holy man (B) **.*

questions.question:
**Direction: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. The post-COVID period has caused many asymptomatic diseases.

B. Though it cannot be believed for sure; the change in social life may be a major cause.

C. These are people who suffered infection once or never at all.

D. Some propose that survival post infection has changed the mindset of people.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"A, C, D, B."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph talks about asymptomatic diseases in the post-COVID period and some proposed causes for it.
 
• Sentence A introduces the topic of asymptomatic diseases. So, it must be the first sentence.
 
• Sentence C provides more information about the people affected by these diseases. So, C must follow A.
 
• Sentence D presents one of the proposed causes for the increase in asymptomatic diseases. So, D must follow C.
 
• Sentence B connects the proposed cause to the topic. So, it must be the last sentence.
 
• The correct answer is option 3.
 
• **Correct sequence**:

 

A. The post-COVID period has caused many asymptomatic diseases.

C. These are people who suffered infection once or never at all.

D. Some propose that survival post infection has changed the mindset of people.

B. Though it cannot be believed for sure; the change in social life may be a major cause.
